contest: Most full sets: whoever holds the most sets of one resource of every color in play when the round ends.

story.line: Yellow rewards going broad and translating currencies (Cory).
story.greatGame: Round I: take Harvest for the exact colors your first member needs, buy Tourist or Counterfeiters, and recruit a different color each time. Round II: Housewarming brings in a missing color for free; your members now cover every color, so one of each keeps flowing in. Round III: Makeover turns a messy pile into full sets right before the count, and Night Traders fixes the last few at round end. Rivals answer by spending before your turn, buying the color you lack out of the shop, or turning your pile one color with their own Counterfeiters.
freshStart: Space, round I: Window Shopping. "Choose a shop member: gain its colored part, in its color. +1 yellow." (first pitched Oct 30, no verdict on record)
Space, round I: Haggle. "+2 yellow. This turn, up to 2 of a member's colored part (3 in round II, 4 in round III) may be paid in any colors." (pitched Oct 30, no verdict on record)
Space, round III: Square Up. "+1 of each color you hold, for each color you hold." (Cory liked it Oct 30; 4 colors pays 16, a lot)
Member: Money Changers. "You may pay a member's colored part with yellow." (Claude's fill-in)
Member: Tailors. "Round Start: +1 follower per full set you hold." (built and tested Nov 4, not picked)

cards.name: Harvest
cards.text: +3 in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III, in colors you choose.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 4 players: I need 2 blue and 1 red to finish a member's colored part; Harvest gives me exactly 2 blue, 1 red and 1 white, and I recruit it the same turn.
cards.topCase: Round III: +5 in colors you pick, about a full set plus one. Build Up gives +5 green and Sleep In +6 purple; Initiation is a free member up to 10. Doesn't break anything.
cards.ideaWhy: Yellow's fuel space, and picking your colors is Yellow's own twist on it.
cards.ties: Feeds shop costs and full sets in any color, so it helps whatever member you're chasing.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 30: "we should give the harvest like actions a little flavor"; Nov 4, on its color picker: "This one doesnt meet the bar" (the screen, not the card).
cards.why: A solid fuel space whose color choice fits Yellow; it never makes a turn anyone remembers.
cards.short: Round II: +4 in exactly the 3 colors you lack, recruit same turn.
cards.risk: Same round I fuel job as Survey.

cards.name: Survey
cards.text: +1 yellow per minion on the busiest color's spaces. +1 yellow.
cards.bestTurn: Last turn of round III, Red's 6 spaces are full: Survey pays 6 + 1 = 7 yellow. Early in round I it pays 2.
cards.topCase: Round III, taken late: 7 yellow at most (a color has 6 spaces), about Sleep In's +6 purple. Building around it isn't possible; you only wait. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Counting another color's crowd pays only yellow: no choosing colors, no going broad, nothing translated.
cards.ties: Pays more when a color's spaces fill up, so it rides other players' choices, but nobody changes a move because of it.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "Leaders tax should be renamed and should be +1 yellow per minion on the most occupied color... that should be the functionality"; name: "maybe, Survey".
cards.why: A second fuel space beside Harvest that only says "wait, then take yellow"; nobody feels it and it isn't about going broad.
cards.short: Round III, last turn: 6 minions on Red's spaces pays 7 yellow.
cards.risk: Same round I fuel job as Harvest.

cards.name: New Blood
cards.text: +2 yellow. This turn, if you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, first member: +2 yellow, recruit a 5-cost red member, +2 more yellow (and +2 more from Guest Book if I hold that cloak): 6 yellow for one turn.
cards.topCase: Round III: +2 then +4 = 6 yellow, only if a color you lack is in the shop and you can pay for it. By round III most cults already hold 4 colors, so it often pays just 2. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: The same "fuel, plus a bonus if you recruit" shape as Gather, Stash and Allowance, with a narrower condition, and its bonus can't be spent until next turn.
cards.ties: Pushes you into a color you don't have, the same trigger as Guest Book and Housewarming.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 3, on the card it replaced (Dilute): "I still don't like Dilute"; Nov 4: "New Blood Should give additional yellow rather than followers".
cards.why: Three colors already have this shape, and Housewarming does the same new-color push with a much bigger moment.
cards.short: Round I: recruit your first red member for 4 yellow total.
cards.risk: Same trigger as Guest Book and Housewarming.

cards.name: Housewarming
cards.text: +2 yellow. Recruit a shop member of a color none of your members have, costing up to 7, for free.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: I have red and blue members; Housewarming brings in a 7-cost white member for free, then I still use my own recruit for a second member. Two members in one turn.
cards.topCase: Round III: a free member up to 7 plus +2 yellow, if a color you lack is in the shop. Initiation is a free member up to 10. Dead once you hold every color plus grey. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: One idea, "a new color moves in, free", and it says going broad.
cards.ties: Takes a member out of the shop, so rivals feel it; the free recruit is the same action as Red's Initiation and Blue's extra recruits.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5, on its cost cap: "for named costs, yes go up by 1" (number only).
cards.why: Yellow's biggest moment on a space, but the action is Red's free recruit; only the new-color condition is Yellow's.
cards.short: Round II: recruit a 7-cost member of a new color for free.
cards.risk: Free recruit is Red's job, like Initiation.

cards.name: Melting Pot
cards.text: +2 yellow, and +1 of each color among your members.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, members in 4 colors: +2 yellow and 1 of each color, so 6 resources and a full set.
cards.topCase: Round III with members of all 4 colors: 6 resources, one of them a full set. Beside Housewarming (a free member) and Initiation it's the smallest round II or III payout. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Members of many colors pay one of each: going broad, said plainly.
cards.ties: Rewards owning many colors of member, so it pairs with Big Tent and Housewarming; nobody else at the table notices it.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 3: "Melting Pot is worded strangely"; Nov 5: "melting pot should give 1 color for each different member color. And when i have dabblers it should give me 1 of every color."
cards.why: A fuel space that pays 5 or 6 in round II beside Housewarming's free member; no one reacts to it.
cards.short: Round II with members in 4 colors: 6 resources, a full set.
cards.risk: Hands a full set, like Caravan.

cards.name: Makeover
cards.text: +4 yellow, then rearrange your resources into any mix of colors.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I hold 16 mixed resources: +4 yellow, rearrange into 5 full sets, take the most-full-sets contest (+10) and still have the exact colors for a 10-cost member.
cards.topCase: Its own gain is 4 yellow, the smallest round III number (Largesse +10 followers, Initiation a free member up to 10); the rest is the contest it can swing, worth +10. With Seamstress it doubles into about 20 more resources, which breaks (see Seamstress).
cards.ideaWhy: Translating currencies, in one move.
cards.ties: Sets up full sets for Yellow's contest and any member's colored part; makes Counterfeiters' damage undoable.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 30: "yes. I think that's right. could maybe be a round II action though with less yellow gain"; Nov 2: "oh no i like makeover as is".
cards.why: Cory likes it as is; it's the one Yellow space that is pure translating.
cards.short: Round III: +4 yellow, rearrange into 5 full sets, win the +10.
cards.risk: With Seamstress, about 30 followers in one turn.

cards.name: Duty Collector
cards.text: Whenever a rival recruits a member of a color you have a member of, +1 of that color.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I hold members of 4 colors: three rivals recruit 5 members between them this round, and I collect 5 resources without a turn.
cards.topCase: Bought round I with 4 colors: about 10 to 12 resources over the game, 3 to 6 in round III. Under Initiation's free 10. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: A toll on colors you share; the broader you are, the more you collect.
cards.ties: Every rival's recruit pays you a little; a rival might steer away from your colors, rarely.
cards.why: Steady and clean, but it pays in small drips nobody reacts to.
cards.short: Round II: rivals recruit 5 members of your colors; you get 5 free.

cards.name: Go-Between
cards.text: Whenever a space gives you resources, you may change 1 of them to any color.
cards.bestTurn: Harvest already lets me pick; on Build Up I turn 1 green into the blue I'm missing for a member.
cards.topCase: Round III, 5 spaces: 5 single changes, no gain. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Small, plain translating.
cards.ties: Smooths shop costs; nobody else notices.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: "i think not. but then it's just the red artifact power?"; Nov 1: replaced by Tourist in the 10-card deck.
cards.why: Out of the 10-card deck already; it changes one resource at a time and never makes a turn.
cards.short: Round III: 5 spaces each turn 1 resource into a color you lack.

cards.name: Tourist
cards.text: On Recruit: +1 follower per color you hold. Round Start: +1 follower per color you hold.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, holding all 4 colors: recruit it for +4 followers, then +4 at the start of rounds II and III.
cards.topCase: Bought round I holding 4 colors: 12 followers plus its own 1, for 9 resources. Bought in round III: 4. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Hold every color, get followers: going broad paid in score.
cards.ties: Makes keeping one of each color worth more than spending it; a Counterfeiters hit on you cuts it to 1.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: "I like tourists. maybe on recruit and round start?"
cards.why: Cory likes it, and it pays going broad in followers, plainly.
cards.short: Round I holding 4 colors: 12 followers over the game.
cards.risk: Same count as Dyer, pays better.

cards.name: Tinker
cards.text: On Recruit: swap up to 3 of your resources one for one. Round Start: swap up to 3 of your resources one for one.
cards.bestTurn: Round start II: I swap 3 extra purple into the blue, red and white I need, then recruit a 6-cost member.
cards.topCase: Bought round I: 9 swaps over the game, no gain. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Translating, but only that.
cards.ties: Same job as Night Traders and Makeover, smaller.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: set to swap 3, On Recruit and Round Start (his verdict, paraphrased in the log).
cards.why: Out of the 10-card deck; swaps that gain nothing, done better by Night Traders and Makeover.
cards.short: Round II start: swap 3 extra purple into blue, red and white.
cards.risk: Fourth way to rearrange, like Makeover and Night Traders.

cards.name: Seamstress
cards.text: On Use, once per game: double your full sets.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I hold 3 full sets: +3 of each color, now 6 sets, and I take the most-full-sets contest for +10.
cards.topCase: Round III with Makeover: +4 yellow, rearrange 20 resources into 5 full sets, then double: +20 resources and the +10 contest. About 30 followers' worth against Initiation's 10. Breaks the game.
cards.ideaWhy: Double what you collected: one plain idea about full sets.
cards.ties: Raises the stakes of Yellow's contest; Counterfeiters on its owner before the use takes it to zero.
cards.why: Its usual turn is fine (about +12), but with Makeover it pays three times the best round III space; weak until capped.
cards.short: Round III: double 3 full sets into 6, take the +10.
cards.risk: With Makeover, about 30 followers in one turn: breaks.

cards.name: Matchmaker
cards.text: Whenever you recruit a yellow member, +3 wild, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I recruit Caravan: +3 resources of my choice and +1 follower on top of Caravan's own full set.
cards.topCase: Bought round I, then 4 more yellow members: +12 resources and +4 followers for 8. Depends on yellow members showing up. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Two rewards stuck together, and it rewards going deep in yellow while the rest of Yellow rewards going broad.
cards.ties: Makes yellow members in the shop worth blocking by rivals.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: "more members should give follower triggers. like side quests"; Nov 5: "matchmaker is good"; Nov 6: "maybe it should just be any yellow member and should be 3 wild".
cards.why: Cory called it good and set its text; note it pulls toward deep, not broad.
cards.short: Round II: recruit Caravan, +3 of any colors and +1 follower.
cards.risk: Pulls toward deep yellow, against going broad.

cards.name: Dyer
cards.text: On Recruit: +1 yellow per color you hold. Round Start: +1 yellow per color you hold.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, holding 4 colors: +4 yellow now, +4 at each later round start.
cards.topCase: Bought round I: 12 yellow for 9. Tourist, cheaper, pays the same count in followers. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Plain, but it's Tourist paying yellow.
cards.ties: Feeds Yellow's own contest and costs; nothing else.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: "i dont like round end"; Nov 5: "eh lets leave it for now".
cards.why: A twin of Tourist that pays yellow instead of followers and costs more.
cards.short: Round I holding 4 colors: 12 yellow over the game.
cards.risk: Tourist pays the same count in followers.

cards.name: Night Traders
cards.text: Round End: before contests are scored, swap up to 4 of your resources for other colors, one for one.
cards.bestTurn: End of round III, tied on full sets: I swap 4 extras into the missing colors, finish 2 more sets and take the +10 alone.
cards.topCase: Round III: 4 swaps right before scoring, worth a round III contest (+10) when you're close. Doesn't break: it needs you near the lead.
cards.ideaWhy: A last-second currency swap before the count.
cards.ties: Leaders in Yellow's and Silver's contests can't trust the board; the swing comes after everyone's last move.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "yes to night market. should be relatively cheap as well"; Nov 6: "buff night traders to 4".
cards.why: Cory picked and buffed it; it makes the contest close tense.
cards.short: Round III end: 4 swaps finish 2 sets, win the +10 alone.
cards.risk: Overlaps Makeover: both rearrange your pile.

cards.name: Leveler
cards.text: On Use, once per round: choose a color; 1 of each rival's biggest color becomes it.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: each rival's biggest pile loses 1 to white, knocking the silver leader down one.
cards.topCase: Round III: 3 resources changed per use, no gain. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: A light nudge to rivals' piles.
cards.ties: Same job as Counterfeiters, far smaller.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: set to On Use, once per round (his verdict, paraphrased in the log).
cards.why: Out of the 10-card deck; Counterfeiters does this job much bigger for less.
cards.short: Round III: 1 of each rival's biggest pile turns white, 3 changed.

cards.name: Counterfeiters
cards.text: On Use, once per round: turn all of a rival's resources into one color you choose.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, the full-sets leader holds 4 sets: I turn all 16 of their resources white, they hold 0 sets, and I take the +10.
cards.topCase: Once a round, one rival's sets and colored costs wiped; worth up to a round III contest swing (10). They can still buy followers with any color. Strong sting, not a break.
cards.ideaWhy: One aggressive move: their money, all one color.
cards.ties: Hits full sets, the silver lead and any member a rival saved for; rivals spend before your turn.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "I think we should have something aggressive, like once per round turn all of a rivals resources into one color."; on price: "i like somebody being able to get it round 1"; name: "maybe counterfeiters?"
cards.why: Cory's own idea, and the one Yellow card every rival feels.
cards.short: Round III: turn the leader's 16 resources white, take the +10.

cards.name: Big Tent
cards.text: Game End: +2 followers per color you have 1 to 3 members of.
cards.bestTurn: Game end, members in all 4 colors: +8 followers.
cards.topCase: At most 8 followers (grey doesn't count) for 9. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Going broad, scored at the end.
cards.ties: Pairs with Housewarming and Melting Pot; nobody reacts.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: "a little similar to HR"; Nov 5, on 1 to 3: "i mean 2".
cards.why: Plain and on theme, but a quiet count at game end.
cards.short: Game end, members in all 4 colors: +8 followers.
cards.risk: Overlaps Spice Route: both count colors at game end.

cards.name: Book Cookers
cards.text: On Use, once per game: rearrange your resources into any mix of colors.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, Makeover is taken: I rearrange 18 resources into 4 full sets and a member's colored part.
cards.topCase: One Makeover without the +4, plus 3 followers of worth. With Seamstress the same break as Makeover.
cards.ideaWhy: Makeover on a card.
cards.ties: Same job as Makeover and Night Traders.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31 (named it): "agree this gives multiple followers".
cards.why: Out of the 10-card deck; a copy of Makeover's rearrange.
cards.short: Round III, Makeover taken: rearrange 18 into 4 full sets.
cards.risk: With Seamstress the same break as Makeover.

cards.name: Caravan
cards.text: On Recruit: +1 of each color. Round Start: +1 of each color.
cards.bestTurn: Round I: recruit it for a full set, then a full set at the start of rounds II and III, plus 3 followers of worth.
cards.topCase: Bought round I: 12 resources (3 full sets) plus 3 followers, for 11. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: A full set every round: plain Yellow.
cards.ties: Feeds Yellow's contest; same job as Melting Pot.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1, why it came in: "way too much 'change rivals resource'… nothing really benefits".
cards.why: Clean and steady, no moment beyond the full set it hands you.
cards.short: Round I: a full set now and each round start, 12 total.
cards.risk: Overlaps Melting Pot: both hand you a full set.

cards.name: Jack-of-All-Trades
cards.text: When counting your full sets (1 of each color), your yellow can stand in for any missing color.
cards.bestTurn: End of round II, I hold 3 red, 3 blue, 6 yellow, no white: yellow fills white and I count 3 full sets, taking the +6.
cards.topCase: Round III: turns the full-sets contest into most yellow for its owner; worth the +10 contest. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Yellow as every color, for the count only.
cards.ties: Only Yellow's contest; makes Counterfeiters into yellow useless against its owner.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5, on its reword: "if we already have the answers, then ship them".
cards.why: Clear and on theme; does Night Traders' contest job more quietly.
cards.short: Round II end: 6 yellow fills missing white, 3 sets, win +6.

cards.name: Spice Route
cards.text: Game End: +1 follower per color you hold 3 or more of.
cards.bestTurn: Game end, 3 or more of all 4 colors: +4 followers.
cards.topCase: At most 4 followers for 8. Flat.
cards.ideaWhy: Hold broad, scored at the end.
cards.ties: Same job as Big Tent, smaller.
cards.why: Out of the 10-card deck; Big Tent's smaller twin.
cards.short: Game end, 3 or more of all 4 colors: +4 followers.
cards.risk: Overlaps Big Tent: both count colors at game end.

cards.name: Guest Book
cards.text: Whenever you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow.
cards.bestTurn: Round I: my first three members are red, blue and grey, so +6 yellow by round II.
cards.topCase: About 5 new colors a game (4 colors plus grey): about 10 yellow, near the cloak target of 10 to 12. Doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Pays going broad, from your own recruits.
cards.ties: Same trigger as New Blood and Housewarming, so they stack on one turn.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: "I think C is probably best"; Nov 1: "yeah it should keep happening in that scenario. Dabblers always works optimally for the player in the logic".
cards.why: Right size and on theme; Cory picked it from a list but hasn't praised it.
cards.short: Round I: first members red, blue, grey: +6 yellow by round II.
cards.risk: Same trigger as New Blood and Housewarming.

overlaps: New Blood ("+2 yellow. This turn, if you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III."), Housewarming ("+2 yellow. Recruit a shop member of a color none of your members have, costing up to 7, for free.") and Guest Book ("Whenever you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow."): one trigger, three cards.

New Blood and Red's Gather ("+2 red in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III."), Magenta's Stash and White's Allowance: the same shape.
Housewarming and Red's Initiation ("Recruit a member in the shop costing 10 or less, for free. +1 red."): both a free recruit, Red's job.
Harvest ("+3 in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III, in colors you choose.") and Survey ("+1 yellow per minion on the busiest color's spaces. +1 yellow."): two fuel spaces in round I.

Tourist ("On Recruit: +1 follower per color you hold. Round Start: +1 follower per color you hold.") and Dyer ("On Recruit: +1 yellow per color you hold. Round Start: +1 yellow per color you hold."): same count, Tourist pays better.

Makeover ("+4 yellow, then rearrange your resources into any mix of colors."), Book Cookers ("On Use, once per game: rearrange your resources into any mix of colors."), Tinker ("swap up to 3 of your resources one for one" on recruit and at round start) and Night Traders ("Round End: before contests are scored, swap up to 4 of your resources for other colors, one for one."): four ways to rearrange your own pile.

Counterfeiters ("On Use, once per round: turn all of a rival's resources into one color you choose.") and Leveler ("On Use, once per round: choose a color; 1 of each rival's biggest color becomes it.").
Melting Pot ("+2 yellow, and +1 of each color among your members.") and Caravan ("On Recruit: +1 of each color. Round Start: +1 of each color."): both hand you a full set.
Big Tent ("Game End: +2 followers per color you have 1 to 3 members of.") and Spice Route ("Game End: +1 follower per color you hold 3 or more of.").
notes: Of the six spaces only Makeover is a clear winner; Survey, New Blood and Melting Pot are fuel spaces with a condition, and the biggest moment (Housewarming) is borrowed from Red. Round II has no Yellow-only big turn. The members are stronger than the spaces: Counterfeiters, Night Traders and Tourist each make a real moment. Seamstress with Makeover is the one break (about 30 followers' worth in one round III turn). Matchmaker pulls toward going deep in yellow, against the color's broad story. Go-Between, Tinker, Leveler, Book Cookers and Spice Route are only in the 15-card deck.
storyShort: Go broad, collect every color, then turn your pile into full sets.
